g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Blue: original observed seasons. Orange dashed: values currently carried forward. Green: new satellite estimates. Grey crosses at the bottom mark failed candidate coverage, not NDVI = 0. Gaps remain gaps. Vertical lines mark December 2023. These are pilot estimates; the analysis release is unchanged.'

text.tspan: Blue: original observed seasons. Orange dashed: values currently carried forward. Green: new satellite estimates.
Grey crosses at the bottom mark failed candidate coverage, not NDVI = 0. Gaps remain gaps.
Vertical lines mark December 2023. These are pilot estimates; the analysis release is unchanged.
